title: 云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第一百三十二章 神机云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第一百三十一章 芳名
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
鼓乐喧腾，众黑衣人齐声欢呼。
被那凌厉无匹的剑所激，许宣汗毛尽竖，体内真气陡然喷涌，浮起两寸来高的橙光气罩，鼓舞起伏。怀里的“紫龙剑”也随之一震，在鞘中铿然长吟
李师师握着他的手，被牢牢地黏在半空透明的蛛网上，红衣鼓舞，剧烈摇荡。火蛛丝又黏又韧，越是挣扎，越寸寸收紧，除非用溶合了“冰蚕粉”的冷水浇泼，否则绝难熔断。两人来势极猛，撞在纵横交错的蛛丝上，顿时被网了个结结实实，再难甩脱。
卡米格格笑道：“贱人，此谓‘以其人之道还治彼身，也汝降青龙之际，可知会有此刻乎？”顿了顿，又森然道：“汝所有之一切，均为吾所赐，吾可捧汝上天，自然亦可打你入地。今日死于吾手，得其所哉”
李师师嘴角泛起一丝若有若无的冷笑，淡淡道：“原来你献计用火蛛丝降伏青龙时，就已经筹划好这一切了。夏花司、秋花司，神祝向你们许了什么诺，让你们也甘心背叛我了？是那半张‘白虎皮图，，还是新任青帝之位？”
那撞钟、吹角的两个黑衣人身子微微一僵，眸中闪过羞惭愧疚之色。许宣这才发觉她们身躯玲珑浮凸，竟然也是女人。
青帝之下，“百花宫”另设“四季花司”，掌管三十三山。这两位能以乐声御使如此庞大的剑阵与八歧大蛇，真之强猛，果然无愧“花司”之位。
卡米格格笑道：“汝为情丝所困，一意孤行，早已众叛亲离矣，何独彼二人乎？就连那……”
话音未落，剑阵拖曳着炽白的强光，如彗星狂舞，呼啸而至。
许宣心中一沉，我命休矣“轰”又是一阵惊雷迭爆，绚光怒爆，漫天如云霞尽染，刺得众人睁不开眼。
然而出乎意料的是，银光缤纷乱舞，那万千飞剑竟没有撞中他们，而是环绕着两人飞旋冲过，接连不断地猛撞在火蛛网上。“嗤嗤”激响，白烟四窜，竟瞬间穿透蛛网，继续朝高塔冲去。
混乱中，只听卡米尖声叫道：“呜呼快走……”强光耀眼，还不等众人看清发生了什么，剑阵已激啸着猛撞在塔顶。狂雷怒震，光浪冲天炸舞，整座高塔瞬间被炸成了万千碎块
乱剑冲天纷飞，碎石如雨，鼓乐、金钟声尽皆断绝。塔下的众人这才如梦初醒，惊呼着四散奔逃。
狂风呼啸，蛛丝尽断，李师师牵着许宣翩然冲落在地，恰好立在浑身血污的卡米面前，淡淡道：“神祝方才想说，我为情丝所困，众叛亲离，就连我最倚信的衤绅霄子，也背叛了我，是不是？”
摇了摇头，柔声道：“可惜你错啦。他若不在你面前出卖我，又怎能取信于你？又怎能引蛇出洞，将你勾结的所有乱党一网打尽？”
卡米面如土色，怒火欲喷，什么话也说不出来了。
许宣背上尽是凉浸浸的冷汗，又惊又喜，虽然还不明白来龙去脉，但已猜到了大概。李师师必是早已料定卡米有谋逆之心，为了除尽乱党，将计就计，故意让心腹“神霄子”参与叛乱，最后关头，反戈一击。而这“神霄子”想必就是真正御使剑阵之人了。
剑阵的锋刃上多半涂抹了可以熔断火蛛丝的“神水”，作势攻击李师师，却瞬间撞碎蛛网，直捣黄龙，攻了乱党一个措手不及。
四周欢呼、呐喊声越来越近，此起彼伏地叫道：“天下无敌，惟我青帝天下无敌，惟我青帝”数百名手持火炬、长剑的飞骑从西崖下率先冲到，接着东边、北边、南边都飞来了上千龙骑，冲落周围。
几个身着男装的青衣美人跃下飞骑，朝着李师师拜倒，娇声道：“陛下神机妙算，叛贼已尽数伏诛”众人纷纷伏身在地，山呼万岁。

“陛下？”许宣耳畔如闻惊雷，猛地转过头，难以置信地望着李师师，“你……你是青帝”
火光摇曳，映照着李师师的脸颊，娇艳如霞，她捋了捋缭乱的发鬓，凝视着他，嫣然一笑：“青帝不过是三十三山的主人。我告诉过你啦，我的名字叫作李师师。普天之下，只有你可以叫我的名字。”
卡米一愣，喘着气格格尖笑：“噫嘻，凤求凰兮凰求凤，阴化阳兮阳化阴有趣之极，有趣之极矣……”话音未落，被她指尖凌空一弹，削去了半个鼻子，捂脸惨叫不绝。
许宣脑中嗡嗡直响，看她眉眼五官，果然与白日见到的青帝颇为相似，又是惊骇，又是懊悔，暗想：“我可真是傻了除了青帝，又有谁会使那‘万壑春藤绕，和‘阴阳指，？”但隐隐之中，仍有些疑窦，不明白当时她为何要女扮男装，又为何要让“百花宫”中的所有男女都颠倒妆扮？
忽听有人高声道：“陛下明鉴此人乃山外来的奸猾小贼，也就是蛇人们所推举的‘伏羲转世，，心狠手辣，口蜜腹剑，所作所为都是为了颠覆‘百花宫，之治，万万不可被他虚情假意所蒙蔽”
content_en:
The drums and music were loud, and all the men in black cheered in unison.
Intrigued by the unparalleled sword, Xu Xuan's hair stood on end, and the true energy in his body suddenly surged, and a two-inch-high orange light aura floated up and down. The "Purple Dragon Sword" in his arms also shook, and it chanted loudly in its sheath.
Li Shishi held his hand and was firmly stuck to the transparent spider web in mid-air. The red clothes were swaying violently. The fire spider silk is sticky and tough. The more it struggles, the tighter it becomes. Unless it is poured with cold water mixed with "ice silkworm powder", it will be difficult to break. The two men came with such force that they collided with the criss-crossing spider silk and were immediately entangled in the web, making it difficult to escape.
Kamig giggled and said: "Bitch, this is called 'treating others in their own way. Did you know that this moment would happen when you descended from the green dragon?'" After a pause, he said solemnly: "Everything you have is given by me. I can lift you to the sky, and I can also beat you to the ground. If you die in my hands today, you will get what you deserve."
A faint sneer appeared at the corner of Master Li's mouth, and he said lightly: "It turns out that you had planned all this when you proposed the plan to use the fire spider silk to subdue the Qinglong. Xiahua Division, Qiuhua Division, what promise did Shenzhu make to you to make you willing to betray me? Is it the half of the 'White Tiger Skin Picture', or the position of the new Qing Emperor?"
The two men in black who were ringing the bell and blowing the horns stiffened slightly, with a look of shame and guilt in their eyes. Only then did Xu Xuan realize that they were also women, with their exquisite bodies.
Under the Qing Emperor, the "Hundred Flowers Palace" established an additional "Flower Department of Four Seasons" to take charge of the Thirty-Three Mountains. These two were able to control such a huge sword array and Yamata no Orochi with their music. They were really powerful and worthy of the position of "Flower Division".
Kami giggled and said: "You are trapped by love and insist on going your own way. You have already betrayed your relatives and left your family, so why are you alone? Even that..."
Before he finished speaking, the sword array trailed a blazing white light, roaring towards him like a comet dancing wildly.
Xu Xuan's heart sank, my life is over. "Boom" was another burst of thunder, and brilliant light exploded, filling the sky like clouds and dyeing it, making everyone unable to open their eyes.
However, unexpectedly, the silver light danced wildly, and the thousands of flying swords did not hit them. Instead, they circled around the two of them and rushed past, slamming into the fire spider web one after another. "Chichi" was aroused, and white smoke flew in all directions. It instantly penetrated the spider web and continued to rush towards the tower.
In the chaos, Kami could only be heard screaming: "Ugh, let's go..." The bright light was dazzling, and before everyone could see what was happening, the sword formation roared and slammed into the top of the tower. Crazy thunder shook, waves of light exploded into the sky, and the entire tower was instantly blown into thousands of pieces.
Swords flew into the sky, gravel rained down, and the sound of drums, music, and golden bells were all cut off. The people under the tower just woke up from a dream, screaming and running away.
The strong wind roared and the spider's thread was cut off. Li Shishi held Xu Xuan and rushed to the ground. He happened to stand in front of the blood-stained Kami and said calmly: "Shenzhu just wanted to say that I was trapped by love, and everyone betrayed me. Even the person I trusted the most, Xun Shenxiao, also betrayed me, didn't he?"
He shook his head and said softly: "It's a pity that you are wrong. If he doesn't betray me in front of you, how can he win your trust? How can he lure the snake out of the hole and catch all the gangsters you have colluded with?"
Kami's face turned earth-colored, and he was so angry that he couldn't say anything.
Xu Xuan's back was covered with cold sweat, and he was surprised and happy. Although he didn't understand the ins and outs, he had already guessed the general idea. Master Li must have long expected that Kami had rebellious intentions. In order to eliminate the rebellious party, he used the trick and deliberately let his confidant "Shen Xiaozi" participate in the rebellion. At the last moment, he turned against him. And this "Shen Xiaozi" must be the real person who controls the sword formation.
The blades of the sword array were mostly coated with "sacred water" that could melt the fire spider silk. They attacked Li Shishi, but they instantly smashed the spider web and went straight to Huanglong, catching the rebels by surprise.
The cheers and shouts from all around were getting closer and closer, one after another shouting: "I am invincible in the world, but I, the Qing Emperor, am invincible in the world."I, the Qing Emperor," hundreds of flying knights holding torches and swords rushed in from the west cliff first, and then thousands of dragon knights flew from the east, north, and south, rushing down around them.
Several beauties in green clothes, dressed in men's clothing, jumped off the flying cavalry, bowed to Master Li, and said softly: "Your Majesty has a wonderful plan, and all the traitors have been killed." Everyone fell to the ground and shouted long live the mountain.
"Your Majesty? "Xu Xuan heard thunder in his ears, turned his head suddenly, and looked at Master Li in disbelief, "You...you are the Qing Emperor"
The firelight swayed, reflecting Li Shishi's cheeks, which were as beautiful as clouds. She smoothed her messy hair, stared at him, and smiled sweetly: "Qing Emperor is just the master of Thirty-Three Mountains. I told you, my name is Master Li. In the whole world, only you can call me by my name. "
Kami was stunned, gasping and laughing loudly: "Hey, the phoenix begs for the phoenix, the phoenix begs for the phoenix, the yin turns into yang, the yang turns into yin, it's so interesting, so interesting..." Before she could finish her words, she flicked her fingertips in the air, cutting off half of her nose, covering her face and screaming.
Xu Xuan's head was buzzing, and looking at her facial features, she was indeed very similar to the Qing Emperor he had seen during the day. He was horrified and regretful at the same time, thinking to himself: "I'm really stupid. Apart from Qing Emperor, who else can make those 'Ten Thousand Valleys Wrapped with Ivy' and 'Yin Yang Finger'?" "But I still have some doubts. I don't understand why she had to dress up as a man at that time, and why she wanted all the men and women in the "Palace of Flowers" to dress up in reverse?
Suddenly I heard someone say loudly: "Your Majesty clearly knows that this person is a cunning little thief from outside the mountain. He is also the reincarnation of Fuxi recommended by the snake people. He is ruthless and ruthless, and his actions are to subvert the rule of Baihua Palace. You must not be fooled by his false intentions."
